drafted_from: tools/keep-and-wake-ai-sessions-on-this-computer/tool-rows.json (tool:connect-an-ai-app-on-this-computer-to-trillion), harness/mcp-registration.mjs, harness/setup.json, test/harness-guidance-mcp-and-runs.test.mjs; the answer was produced by running registerMcp in an empty temporary home
start_here: Say to your AI: "Show me what changes in my Cursor config if you add the Trillion connection, and do not write anything until I say yes." It previews the change with action mcp-preview and client cursor.
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it reads and edits only the config files of the AI apps you name on this computer.
instructions: 1. Say "Preview adding the Trillion connection to cursor". The AI reads this tool's row with tools:list, then runs its command on your computer: node tools/keep-and-wake-ai-sessions-on-this-computer/harness/setup.mjs --action mcp-preview --client cursor (the folder is the root of the Workshop checkout after npm ci).
2. Read each app's result: now is absent, registered, outdated, custom, blocked or not_installed, and diff shows the exact lines that would be added. Nothing is written by mcp-inspect or mcp-preview.

3. If you agree, say yes. The AI runs the same command with --action mcp-register and --reviewed set to the review_hash the preview answered; if a file changed since the preview, it answers refused and writes nothing, so preview again.
4. Do the sign_in step each result names in that app. To undo, run --action mcp-unregister with the same --client; an entry that was yours (custom) is never changed or removed.

worked_examples.title: Preview the Trillion entry for Cursor on a computer that has Cursor and no entry yet
worked_examples.ask: Show me what changes in my Cursor config if you add the Trillion connection, and do not write anything until I say yes.
worked_examples.given: Run from harness/mcp-registration.mjs (registerMcp with the shipped harness/setup.json) in an empty temporary home that holds only an empty .cursor folder, because this tool runs on the person's computer and cannot be run through the door. The command line the AI runs after reading the row: node tools/keep-and-wake-ai-sessions-on-this-computer/harness/setup.mjs --action mcp-preview --client cursor. The temporary file path differs on every computer.
